title: Cinnamon Rolls
description: Soft, fluffy yeasted cinnamon rolls with a buttery brown sugar swirl and cream cheese frosting, made with instant yeast.
scaleNote: A double batch needs two {len 9x13 in} pans.
equipment: Stand mixer with dough hook, or a big bowl and some elbow grease

image.alt: A pan of cinnamon rolls with swirls and white glaze

steps.text: In the mixer bowl, stir the warm milk, yeast and sugar together. Add the eggs and softened butter, then the flour and salt. Knead with the dough hook on medium-low until smooth and slightly tacky, {time 6-8 min}.
Cover the bowl and let the dough rise somewhere warm until doubled, {time 1 hr notimer}.
Grease the baking pan. Roll the dough on a floured counter into a {len 16x12 in} rectangle. Spread the soft butter over it, then sprinkle evenly with the brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll it up tightly from a long side and pinch the seam closed. Cut into {count 12} even rolls with a sharp knife or dental floss and set them cut side up in the pan.
Cover and let rise until puffy and touching, {time 30-45 min notimer}. Meanwhile heat the oven to {temp 350F oven}.
Bake until golden and the center rolls read {temp 190F internal}, {time 22-26 min}. Beat the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth, and spread it over the warm rolls.

notes: Overnight: after shaping, cover the pan and refrigerate for up to 16 hours. Let the rolls sit at room temperature for 45 minutes before baking.
Warm milk should feel like a warm bath. Too hot and it kills the yeast.
